―'''Dispatcher''' on Wave 10 of [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] (Hard, [[Operation I.C.E Event]])}} }} ==Description== '''Dispatcher''' is a narrator that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, [[Failed Gateway]], [[The Nightmare Realm]], [[Containment]], [[Pls Donate]], [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], [[Bathroom Approach]], [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] maps. She is a high ranking member of the [[T.D.S. Organization]], often being in control of multiple important operations. ==Appearance== '''Dispatcher''' has pale skin. She wears a white shirt, blue vest with yellow buttons, blue pants with a black belt and black shoes. She has grey straps around her shoulders and a Paradoxum Games logo pin on her vest. She can hold various objects in its animations, which include her radio, an M1911 pistol, clipboard and binoculars. ==Icons== {| class="article-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:95%; margin: 0 auto" !Neutral !Aggressive !Teach !Scared |- |[[File:DispatcherNeutral.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:DispatcherAggressive.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:DispatcherThinking.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:DispatcherScared.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |- !Sneaky !Disappointed !Thinking !No Animation |- |[[File:DispatcherSneaky.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:DispatcherDisappointed.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:DispatcherThinking2.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:DispatcherNoAnim.png|center|thumb|175px]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} adidas Backyard Legends Trailer ⚽ - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Dispatcher''' on a promotional video. adidas Backyard Legends Alternate Resolution - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Dispatcher''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Hexscape Night 3 Cutscene 3|'''Dispatcher''' in the ending [[Containment]] cutscene. TDS Chapter 1- The Beginning Cutscene|'''Dispatcher''' in [[The Beginning]]. }} ==Trivia== *'''Dispatcher''' shares the same animations with the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]. *'''Dispatcher's''' real name is Jane, as revealed in by the [[Commander]] in the ending cutscene of [[Blind Faith]], Night 3 of the [[Null & Void Event]]. *After the events of [[Blind Faith]], she was taken by [[Lord Exo]] to become the vessel for [[The Umbra]]. *The clipboard that '''Dispatcher''' holds actually has something at the front. It is a petition to make whiney congressmen play violent video games. **The reason for this random paper to be on it is that the clipboard model was taken from ''Postal 2's'' [[w:c:postal:Clipboard|Clipboard]]. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **'''Dispatcher''' added. {{NarratorNavBox}} [[Category:Characters]]
